description: Functional refactoring suggestions (light bulb quick fixes) for F#, built on FSharp.Analyzers.SDK. Over 180 rules covering correctness, performance, idiom and redundancy. Suggestions are Hint severity and never gate a build; the priority rules show as warnings in the editor.
releaseNotes:
0.8.56: One build, for FSharp.Analyzers.SDK 0.43 (FsAutoComplete 0.87+, fsharp-analyzers 0.43); 0.8.55 is the last release for SDK 0.41. FR0118 leaves Stream's own calls (WriteAsync, CopyToAsync) on a stream over memory: a MemoryStream, or an immutable binding made from memory streams only.

 0.8.55: FR0119 leaves in-memory streams and writers, the console, EF Core Add/AddRange and members named for their synchronous work; FR0119 and FR0049 bind with .ConfigureAwait(false) where the task body's own binds all do. FR0075 leaves an object of the solution's own type built with a null argument, and trusts a System.* callee only from an assembly signed with a runtime key. FR0160 stays a note where the try sets an HTTP header. FR0007 keeps mutable on a local an inactive #if branch writes. FR0118 leaves the explicit CancellationToken.None of a call named for cleanup. FR0124 lets Serilog read a repeated {0} once in an all-positional template, and counts every hole for Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.

 0.8.54: The fsharp-refactor tool gains --exclude-codes; the analyzers are unchanged.

 0.8.53: A generator's banner is read at the end of a header line (`module X // generated by ...`) and below an attribute of several lines.

 0.8.52: One build, for FSharp.Analyzers.SDK 0.41 (FsAutoComplete 0.86+, Ionide 8+, fsharp-analyzers 0.41), in analyzers/dotnet/fs; the SDK 0.37 and 0.35 builds are gone, and 0.8.51 is the last release for older hosts.

 0.8.51:A build for FSharp.Analyzers.SDK 0.41 (FsAutoComplete 0.86, Ionide 8, fsharp-analyzers 0.41), and one folder per build: analyzers/dotnet/fs (0.41), fs-sdk0.37, fs-sdk0.35. Point an editor at analyzers/dotnet and the CLI at the folder for its version. The package declares no dependency: FSharp.Compiler.Service and the analyzer SDK landed in the bin of applications referencing it. Prose such as "types generated by JsonProvider" no longer marks a file generated.

 0.8.50: FR0029's return hoist no longer takes the `elif` links after an awaiting arm as a branch of their own: it put `return` in front of the `elif` keyword, which didn't compile, and the build check rolled the edit back.
